title: Works well, but sprays hot water and leaks.
text: Works well, but sprays hot water and leaks.. So this little guy is inexpensive and does the job. But I agree with the reviews about safety concerns. As it heats up, water bubbles out of all cracks and openings. This makes a mess on your counter and definitely can burn you. I have taken to wearing an oven mitt while using it, to be safe. I read all of the warnings and followed all of the rules and still was splattered with hot water.  I have found it is a tad safer to only fill the water halfway up, so as it boils, the bubbles don't spill over. So, it works and is portable and cheap. But, yes, it also can be dangerous. Use caution!
